children.value: > Fact From Story: Google and Apple both treat developers as adversaries — they try to attack our revenue streams and prevent us from competing with their products.
> > Fact From Story: They’ve built these massive self-preferencing schemes all around excluding developers and disadvantaging third-party developers.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Self-preferencing schemes disadvantage those who are not preferred.
> Commonsense Knowledge: An adversary is someone who is actively competing with or hostile towards another.
